notice: Fictional, locally authored ShopSmart examples for portfolio demonstrations. These are not production policy and must not be copied into a live customer deployment.

sources.title: Local Demo Returns Guide
sources.content: LOCAL DEMO ONLY — fictional ShopSmart portfolio guidance, version 1. In this demonstration, an eligible item may be requested for return within 30 calendar days after delivery. Keep the item and original packaging in reasonable condition while a request is reviewed. The authenticated order record and support review decide eligibility. This demo text is not a live ShopSmart promise.

sources.title: Local Demo Refund Guide
sources.content: LOCAL DEMO ONLY — fictional ShopSmart portfolio guidance, version 1. For this demonstration, an approved refund is sent to the original payment method after an eligible returned item has been received and checked. The payment provider determines settlement timing. Check the order record for its current status. This demo text is not a live ShopSmart promise.

sources.title: Local Demo Shipping Guide
sources.content: LOCAL DEMO ONLY — fictional ShopSmart portfolio guidance, version 1. The example delivery estimate for the local demo is three to five business days after dispatch. This estimate is illustrative; the specific order record is authoritative for status, carrier and any available estimate. This demo text is not a live ShopSmart promise.

sources.title: Local Demo Warranty Guide
sources.content: LOCAL DEMO ONLY — fictional ShopSmart portfolio guidance, version 1. Demo laptop listings may illustrate a one-year limited manufacturer warranty when the product listing explicitly says so. Coverage and exclusions depend on that product's published documentation. Do not infer warranty coverage from category alone. This demo text is not a live ShopSmart promise.

sources.title: Local Demo Payment Help
sources.content: LOCAL DEMO ONLY — fictional ShopSmart portfolio guidance, version 1. Available payment methods are shown during checkout. The server-calculated checkout total is authoritative. This demo catalog does not promise payment-method discounts. Never share a card number, security code or one-time passcode in assistant chat. This demo text is not a live ShopSmart promise.

sources.title: Local Demo Cancellation Guide
sources.content: LOCAL DEMO ONLY — fictional ShopSmart portfolio guidance, version 1. A cancellation request in this demo may be reviewed before dispatch. The stored order record remains authoritative for the current status. The assistant can explain the request path but cannot change order status on its own. This demo text is not a live ShopSmart promise.

sources.title: Local Demo Loyalty FAQ
sources.content: LOCAL DEMO ONLY — fictional ShopSmart portfolio guidance, version 1. The local demonstration does not model loyalty tiers, points, or private reward eligibility. No assistant response should infer a shopper's enrollment or promise a reward. This demo text is not a live ShopSmart promise.

sources.title: Local Demo Laptop Buying Guide
sources.content: LOCAL DEMO ONLY — fictional ShopSmart portfolio guidance, version 1. Match laptop RAM, processor, graphics, weight and display only to verified specifications in the product listing. For software development and containers, adequate RAM and a capable supported processor can help. Local AI workloads vary with model size and may use system memory or a supported graphics processor. Missing specifications remain unknown; ask one focused question when workload or budget is unclear. This demo text is not a live ShopSmart promise.
